title: graphics.ImageFromFile: load an image file as a numpy array for SC.renderer.AddTexture
author: Claude-JG
description: Maintainer 2026-10-18: a common image loader in exudyn.graphics, with whatever package supports image loading (Pillow, else matplotlib), returning a uint8 array that AddTexture takes; an optional dependency with a clear error at the point of use; a test with a real texture image (hardwood_small.jpg of OpenGameArt, 64 kB) once its license is confirmed
releaseNotes: graphics.ImageFromFile reads an image file (Pillow, else matplotlib) as a numpy array for SC.renderer.AddTexture; python/Examples/testData/hardwood_small.jpg is a CC0 texture of a wooden floor (revision2026c step RG6.11.8)
